description: This PHP source file defines a class Upgrade1 within the Opencart\Install\Controller\Upgrade namespace. The class handles the process of upgrading and modifying configuration files for the Opencart e-commerce system, specifically managing changes to config.php files for both catalog and admin sections during installation or upgrade procedures.

classes.name: Upgrade1
classes.description: A controller class that manages the upgrade process for configuration files during system upgrades, including reading existing config files, verifying server environment settings, creating new configuration files, and handling potential directory restructuring.
